counterexample: Tick spacing 10. One position [100, 200), so ticks 100 and 200 are initialized. Start 100, end 50. The end tick is a multiple of the spacing, so the extra condition fails and the search begins strictly below 100. The walk returns nothing; it should return [100].
summary: Returns the start tick first only when the start is a multiple of the tick spacing, the end tick is not, and the start's net liquidity is not zero. With an aligned end tick, or a start tick whose net liquidity is zero, the start tick is still skipped, which is why attack P5 still works.
